admission.justification: Prevents treating temporary-file cleanup as a Windows guarantee or allowing an uncertain process probe to invalidate a completed atomic publish.

applicability: Post-publication cleanup of same-target interrupted-write temporaries on non-Windows platforms.
conditions: The temporary name matches the target and writer naming pattern.
The process probe establishes that the writer is gone before unlinking.
exclusions: Windows, where this cleanup is deliberately skipped.
Live or unknown writers, malformed names, other targets and files that cannot be removed.

evidence: notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L41-reviewer-acd0dccb-066d-41e9-ab45-b3d7e19e742f.md; probe x32_atomic_write_edges.out; three killed mutations under sealed id 14

statement: On non-Windows platforms, the next successful atomic write attempts to remove same-target temporary files only when the process probe establishes their writer is gone; live, unknown and unremovable temporaries remain without invalidating the completed publish.
